style.look: flat 2D cartoon, round-headed chibi characters, bold dark outlines, dark moody night environment, layered depth (blurred far layers, sharp mid layer, blurred foreground), fog, glowing light sources, vignette and film grain

scenes.narration: A normal night in a normal city.
scenes.visual: Establishing shot of a quiet town at night. People walking home. Atmosphere: calm but slightly uneasy.
scenes.caption: ONE QUIET NIGHT

scenes.narration: Then one man collapses. He does not get up the same.
scenes.visual: Dark alley. A single man stumbles, collapses and turns into a zombie. Finish on a tense close-up of his face.
scenes.caption: PATIENT ZERO

scenes.narration: Within days the infection is everywhere.
scenes.visual: Top-down map of the city. Infection spreads outward over several days, with a day counter.
scenes.caption: THE CITY FALLS
